Introduction

HITGS is a South Korean girl group formed by H Music Entertainment. The group's name is an abbreviation for Hip, Innocent, Teenager, Girls, Story.

They officially debuted on April 28, 2025, with the single album Things we love : H and its title track "Sourpatch."

Prior to their debut, the group was known as Project H and gained attention for their pre-debut appearances, including a performance at the 2024 SBS Gayo Daejeon pre-show, as well as attending events such as the TIRTIR pop-up store opening and 2025 F/W Seoul Fashion Week.
